hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat) && filepath=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [ -n "$filepath" ] && [[ "$filepath" == *.py ]]; then ruff format --quiet "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --quiet "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi

INPUT=$(cat) && filepath=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if [ -n "$filepath" ]; then case "$filepath" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.env|*/.env.*) echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit .env files directly. Use .envrc or ask the user.' >&2; exit 2;; */migration_lock.toml) echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit Prisma migration lock directly.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi

INPUT=$(cat) && cmd=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // .tool_input.cmd // empty') && if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then case "$cmd" in *"git reset --hard"*|*"git checkout --"*|*"git clean -fd"*|*"git push --force"*|*"git push -f"*|*"rm -rf /"*|*"rm -rf ~"*|*"docker compose down -v"*|*"prisma migrate reset"*|*"dropdb "*) echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command requires explicit user confirmation in chat.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$cmd" in *"ZINC-FUSION-V15-recovery-dirty"*|*"ZINC-FUSION-V15-deploy-fix"*|*"ZINC-FUSION-V15-integration-clean"*|*"ZINC-FUSION-V15-integration"*|*"ZINC-FUSION-V15_RECOVERED"*) echo 'BLOCKED: Operate only in /Volumes/Satechi Hub/ZINC-FUSION-V15 unless user explicitly redirects.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi
